# Tidewater Ferries refund policy

This policy applies to every ticket sold through the Tidewater booking app.

## Cancelling a booking

- Cancel **more than 48 hours** before departure: full refund.
- Cancel **between 48 and 6 hours** before departure: 50% refund.
- Cancel **less than 6 hours** before departure: no refund. The ticket can
  still be transferred to another passenger for free.

## Weather cancellations

When Tidewater cancels a sailing because of weather, passengers choose
between a full refund and free rebooking on any sailing within 30 days.

## Processing

Refunds go back to the original payment method and take 5 business days to
process. Tidewater never refunds in cash at the terminal.
